format: drawn controls, painted strings and choice options (<= 40) of every panel and dialog; see capture_emtk_populated.py

interactive.label: host
interactive.tooltip: The MMFDB server: the host of the embedded server, or the base URL of a standalone one. Login connects here.

interactive.label: port
interactive.tooltip: The server's command port (its publish port is the next one).

interactive.label: user
interactive.tooltip: The MMFDB user to sign in as.

interactive.label: password
interactive.tooltip: The password. Not needed when this ChiSurf session is already signed in, or the account may sign in without one. Never stored.
More connection and authentication options: the login dialog (sign in as another user, or connect to another server).

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: Reload the MMFDB status and the open panel.

interactive.tooltip: Import fluorescence, sample or project data (PDBx / PDB-IHM / FLR CIF) into the MMFDB.

interactive.label: Backup
interactive.tooltip: Create a backup copy of the active MMFDB database.

interactive.tooltip: Reset the active MMFDB database to the curated source. A backup is created first (asks first).

interactive.tooltip: Find a panel by name or description.

interactive.tooltip: Import PDBx / PDB-IHM / FLR CIF files; export a sample as FLR CIF or the sample table.
